meta.name: Zirve Metal Industrial Service DNA
meta.description: Premium, sade ve gerçek tesis fotoğraflarına dayalı çelik servis merkezi deneyimi.

primary.role: logo, brand identity and selected technical emphasis

accent.role: laser trace and primary action only

neutral.usage: Dark architectural grounds, cool steel dividers and high-contrast light ink.

color.contrast_strategy: High-contrast light text on dark steel grounds; localized corner or column scrims over photography.

typography.font_style_notes: Condensed industrial display face with a clear humanist body face; headlines carry strength without faux-tech decoration.

spacing.section_rhythm: Alternates compact factual bands with full-viewport photographic acts; mobile spacing compresses fluidly.

layout.grid_system: 12-column fluid grid with asymmetric editorial spans

shape.border_usage: Subtle 1px steel hairlines and orange laser rules; pill reserved for circular controls only.
shape.divider_style: Technical hairline with occasional cut marks.

elevation.depth_cues: Overlapping photo planes, edge light, controlled parallax and localized scrims.

iconography.preferred_set: Custom inline SVG using square geometry

motion.entrance_pattern: Short line or clip reveals driven by scroll progress
motion.exit_pattern: Crossfade or cut after a readable plateau
motion.philosophy: Cinematic but controlled; scroll supplies the energy and UI remains fast.

components.button_style: Square, compact, direct labels, orange primary and transparent outline secondary
components.input_style: Dark open fields with bottom or 1px steel border and visible focus
components.card_style: Asymmetric photo plates and factual museum-style labels; no repeated icon-card grid
components.navigation_pattern: Fixed low-profile dark rail with wordmark, section links and one WhatsApp action
components.component_notes: One CTA label everywhere; corners remain sharp across surfaces.

aesthetic.visual_metaphor: A laser line travelling through a working steel service centre

visual_language.whitespace_usage: Generous around claims, compressed around inventory facts
visual_language.visual_weight_distribution: Large photographic fields balanced by condensed type blocks
visual_language.focal_strategy: Progressive reveal culminating in CNC laser precision
visual_language.texture_usage: Real steel surfaces, subtle grain and dot-grid only

composition.flow_direction: Vertical journey with one lateral inventory movement
composition.grouping_strategy: Proximity, hairlines and shared image labels
composition.negative_space_role: Creates calm before the laser-cut peak

imagery.photo_treatment: Real architectural and documentary photographs, cool-neutral grade, preserved oxide and daylight tones
imagery.illustration_style: No decorative illustration; technical SVG line only
imagery.graphic_elements: Laser trace, cut marks, dimension ticks and restrained grid
imagery.pattern_usage: Low-opacity dot grid on selected dark grounds
imagery.image_shape: Full bleed, wide cinematic crop and sharp rectangular product plates

interaction_feel.hover_behavior: Small translation, edge highlight and image scale below 1.03
interaction_feel.loading_style: Real poster remains until Instagram content is explicitly requested

brand_voice_in_ui.empty_state_approach: Plain explanation with a direct external option

overview.fallback_strategy: Static photographs, completed laser trace and native horizontal scrolling under reduced motion or without JavaScript

background_effects.description: Subtle film grain and technical dot grid on dark steel surfaces

scroll_triggered_animations.animation_type: photo scrub, line reveal, pan, clip reveal and count

scroll_morphing.description: The persistent laser trace changes from vertical route to horizontal cutting path at the CNC peak.

text_effects.description: Selected hero and peak headlines assemble by line

cursor_effects.description: Only the closing WhatsApp action responds subtly to a precise pointer

image_effects.description: Real facility and product photography enters through structural wipes

svg_animations.description: A laser trace records the journey and becomes the CNC cutting path

params.filter_effects: localized warm core only at the CNC peak

visual_effects.composite_notes: The laser trace is the only conspicuous effect. Real imagery remains dominant, and every motion layer resolves to static content for reduced-motion users.
